## Bug Reports

**Please include:**
- Python version (`python3 --version`)
- The exact command that failed
- Full error traceback
- What you expected vs what happened

Open an issue: https://github.com/wali-reheman/fly-smart/issues/new/choose

## Feature Requests

Open an issue: https://github.com/wali-reheman/fly-smart/issues/new/choose

Describe the use case (route, dates, what you'd save) and your proposed solution.
